ingest.intro: The code is analyzed in an isolated environment with no internet access. Nothing from the system is executed.
ingest.privacy: Everything stays on this server: no tool queries external services.

explain.title: What are we going to review?
explain.security: patterns that allow injections, XSS, exposed secrets.
explain.deps: libraries with known vulnerabilities, according to the local database.
explain.secrets: passwords, keys and tokens left in the code or its history.
explain.health: complexity per function, lines per language, commented-out code.
